payload.name: H-shape pattern
payload.fact: Users' eye movement patterns on Facebook exhibit an H-shape pattern, which differs from the F-shape pattern typically observed on other web pages.
payload.boundary: Attributed to the unique user interface of Facebook, specifically the right-side and vertical arrangement of advertisements.
